deploy-bot: Canary deploy STARTED for service=inference-runtime tag=v2.7.3-canary commit=9f3a1b region=prod-usw2 traffic=5% change_window=15m operator=@alex :rocket:
alex: kicking off smoke tests now, will report back in ~5m
maya: tails on oncall box, seeing a small blip of 502s from the edge during the first minute, investigating
alex: copying logs, tail of envoy on one host shows repeated `upstream read timeout` for the batching pool
maya: note: batcher pods warmed but one instance OOM-killed earlier — restarted, OOM not during canary but low mem headroom
jen: product note: low risk feature flags off for this tag, no schema changes. holding only if error_rate > 0.5% or p95 > 400ms
deploy-bot: Canary health snapshot (5m): p50=43ms p95=210ms error_rate=0.18% qps=120 cache_hit=68% (baseline cache_hit=63%) — suggested action: promote to 20% if stable for 10m
sam: recommend promote to 20% and run 30m smoke on top of that, set rollback threshold error_rate>0.5% or p95>400ms
maya: fixed nginx envoy route timeout (increased from 10s -> 20s) on the few hosts that tripped, monitoring, errors normalized
alex: smoke results: generate request set A (sanity) and B (edge throughput) both passed, no 5xxs in last 8m
deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: 20% -> starting now. pinned_tag=temp-pin/v2.7.3-canary operator=@alex
ci-bot: Draft release note created: https://internal.ci/release/notes/v2.7.3-canary (please add bullet about batcher memory headroom fix)
jen: thanks, will add note about feature flag posture
maya: watching metrics during 20% window, tailing logs for batching errors and OOMs
(12m later) deploy-bot: 20% window complete: p50=44ms p95=230ms error_rate=0.22% (within thresholds). no new OOMs. suggestion: continue to 50% for 20m
sam: +1 for 50%, let's do staged ramp: 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 20m hold at each step, rollback if thresholds breached
deploy-bot: Ramp step -> 50% starting. policy=staged duration=20m rollback_thresholds={"error_rate": "0.5%", "p95": "400ms"} operator=@alex
alex: running A/B fuzz tests against production prompts during 50% window, will post results if any drift
(25m later) deploy-bot: 50% hold complete: p95=240ms error_rate=0.25% CPU stable, KV cache hit +6% across canary. No rollback triggered. proceeding to 100% per policy
deploy-bot: PROMOTE to 100%: tag v2.7.3 now pinned as stable at commit=9f3a1b. change_window=closed operator=@alex :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Release note updated and published to docs: https://internal.ci/releases/v2.7.3 — draft -> published. Changelog: small envoy timeout tweak, batcher stability fix, performance improvements on kv-cache hits
maya: quick smoke post-promote looks clean, no elevated 5xxs, tracing shows KV cache warm start successful
alex: commands used to pin (for audit):
```
# pin tag to prod
deployctl pin --service inference-runtime --tag v2.7.3 --env prod-usw2 --by alex
```
deploy-bot: Deployment COMPLETE. Metrics window (final): p50=46ms p95=255ms error_rate=0.21% incidents=0 pinned_tag=v2.7.3 release_id=rel-2026-03-20-0923
jen: nice work team :tada: please monitor dashboards for 2h and report any regressions
sam: adding followup ticket to perf board to revisit batcher memory defaults, thanks all
alex: standing down unless anything else crops up. great job everyone :thumbsup:
